name: Flooring Decisions for Fix-and-Flip Investors in Renton and King County
title-tag: Fix-and-Flip Flooring Guide | Renton & King County
meta-description: Refinish the oak under the carpet or install new? A King County contractor gives investors the flip flooring math — costs, timelines, and what buyers reward.
post-summary: October 12, 2026 · In Renton's Boeing-era ramblers there's usually red oak under the carpet, and refinishing it at $3.99/sq ft beats any new install on cost, speed, and buyer reaction. The flip flooring decision tree: when to refinish, when LVP earns its place, and how to sequence the work.
